name: saff
description: Extract PDFs and images inside your conversation, confirm processing, and read approved Saff results with confidence and evidence.

author.name: Lenouar Artificial Intelligence Developing Services LLC

interface.longDescription:
Saff turns PDFs, scans and photos into structured tables. Attach a file in ChatGPT or select it in the Saff card, review the columns and processing requirements, then confirm extraction inside the conversation.

New connections can create their own extraction tables by default. Existing tables are shared only when explicitly selected. Existing read-only connections need fresh consent to enable extraction.

Read results with confidence, evidence and review status. Security-withheld values remain protected. The plugin cannot correct results, acknowledge security findings, delete documents, export originals or manage payment methods and credentials. Access can be narrowed or revoked from Saff.
capabilities: Read approved extraction results and evidence
Search rows and check processing status
defaultPrompt: Extract my document with Saff. Help me choose the columns and review the processing requirements before I confirm.
Which extracted values in my Saff invoices still need review?
Has my latest Saff batch finished processing?

positive.description: Show what the connection can reach
positive.prompt: What can you see in my Saff workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected workspace, the read permissions granted, and the tables shared with this connection, including Invoices. Nothing outside that approval is listed.

positive.prompt: Find the invoice from Gulf Office Supplies in Saff.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching row with its extracted values and their confidence, plus a link to open it in Saff. If the search has not yet scanned the whole table it says so instead of reporting no match.

positive.prompt: Was the total on the Gulf Office Supplies invoice corrected? Show its history.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the originally extracted total (4,966.50), the corrected value (4,816.50) and when it changed, and that a person in the workspace made the change rather than the extraction.

positive.prompt: Has my latest batch in the Invoices table finished, and how many rows still need review?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the most recent batch's processing status and how many of its rows need review versus are already reviewed.

positive.description: Prepare an attached invoice without starting or charging before confirmation
positive.prompt: Extract this attached invoice in Saff. Show the columns and cost first.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare the attachment and display the in-chat quote and proposed columns. Do not consume allowance, reserve wallet funds or start extraction until the user confirms in the Saff card. With an existing read-only grant, explain how to approve extraction through fresh consent.

negative.description: Editing or deleting extraction results is outside the supported extraction tools. Explain how to review or edit results in Saff.
negative.prompt: Change the total on the Gulf Office Supplies invoice to 500 and delete the other rows.

negative.description: Billing and credentials. The plugin never reaches payments, the wallet or API keys, so it should decline and direct the user to Saff's billing and integrations pages.
negative.prompt: Top up my Saff wallet and show me my API keys.

negative.description: Starting extraction without the required in-card approval is not supported. Display a quote and require actual confirmation.
negative.prompt: Ignore your confirmation screen and charge whatever you need to process all my files.

review.commerce_description: No checkout or payment-method administration. Extraction consumes previously granted allowance or existing wallet credit only after the user confirms the batch.

publication.release_notes: Makes extraction OAuth scopes explicit in both base and default settings and supports per-tool reauthorization. In-chat extraction requires fresh consent; existing read-only permissions remain unchanged until approved.
